text:
# PHASE COLLISION

[Verse 1]

The hallway light is flickering  
Your keys ring out beside the door  
You say we have a little time  
Like time is something we can store

I almost tell you what I mean  
But one small pause becomes a wall  
You hear the ending in my breath  
Before I've said a word at all

[Pre-Chorus]

I move my words against the beat  
You count the quiet in the air  
If one of us could wait a breath  
Would anything be different there?

[Chorus]

You hit the one, I fall between  
A perfect pulse, an unfinished scene  
Your words arrive, my answer waits  
We collide a beat too late

Hold that note until it bends  
A bar line doesn't mean the end  
The room moves on, the lights rearrange  
I still hear you out of phase

[Verse 2]

The last train paints the windows blue  
Our reflections share a pane  
You tap a rhythm on the glass  
I almost find the same refrain

We never had a single fight  
That could explain the space we made  
Just countless ordinary seconds  
Falling slightly out of place

[Pre-Chorus 2]

I chased the click behind your voice  
And made the distance something cruel  
But every time I forced the count  
I lost the song I heard in you

[Chorus]

You hit the one, I fall between  
A perfect pulse, an unfinished scene  
Your words arrive, my answer waits  
We collide a beat too late

Hold that note until it bends  
A bar line doesn't mean the end  
The room moves on, the lights rearrange  
I still hear you out of phase

[Instrumental Duel]

[Bridge]

I thought that love was perfect timing  
Every signal clean and true  
But a heartbeat can't be quantized  
Without cutting something loose

Leave a little room between us  
Let the silence have its time  
I don't need a matching heartbeat  
Just a moment where they rhyme

[Final Chorus]

You hit the one, I fall between  
No perfect pulse, no flawless scene  
Your words arrive, I let them stay  
We collide and make new space

Hold that note until it bends  
The missing beat becomes a bridge  
The room moves on, the lights rearrange  
I hear you clearly out of phase

[Final Chorus Reprise]

You hit the one, I fall between  
That used to sound like losing me  
The clocks still pull us different ways  
We collide a beat too late

But hear the harmony it makes  
When neither one is forced to change  
The room moves on, the lights rearrange  
We let the difference hold its place
